# Plaster Stone Wall 01

Original asset by Charlotte Baglioni, distributed by Poly Haven under CC0.

- Asset: https://polyhaven.com/a/plaster_stone_wall_01
- License: https://polyhaven.com/license
- CC0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
- Download URLs and SHA-256 hashes: sources.json

The unmodified 2K JPEG color, OpenGL normal, and AO/roughness/metal maps
are embedded as the large cathedral's carved-stone material. The geometry
uses world-space UVs repeated every 1.5 metres; each map receives runtime
mipmaps. This is an illustrative worn finish, not a historical reconstruction.
